mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ips.security_type ,dst.security_type_name FROM ip_pool_status_fund ips INNER JOIN dict_security_type dst ON dst.security_type = ips.security_type AND dst.category_type = 'fund' AND dst.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' ORDER BY dst.sort_order ASC ,ips.security_type ASC
